record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare PYRO_BALL in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count, stats and (for Scorbunny and Raboot) the HATCH passive, which this record does not cover.
record.summary: The caster picks its farthest targettable enemy (PokemonState.getFarthestTarget, strictly greater Manhattan distance wins, scan order on ties) or, if there is none, the cast target, and every unit of another team on the supercover line from the caster's cell to that unit (both ends included) is collected once. Each unit hit is set burning for 2000 ms (requested; origin = the caster) and then takes SPECIAL damage (raw 10/20/40/80 by caster stars). The burn is applied before the damage and is skipped per target by IMMUNITY_BURN, rune protect or the WATER_BUBBLE passive, without cancelling the damage. If no enemy stands on the line, the cast target alone is burned and damaged. The caster does not move.

targeting.who: every unit of another team on the cells between the caster and its farthest targettable enemy; fallback: the cast target
targeting.note: Farthest selection: distanceM (Manhattan) from the caster over all cells holding a targettable enemy, strictly greater wins, so ties keep the first enemy in Board.forEach order (rows outer, columns inner). The line is collected with a team filter only, not isTargettableBy, so an untargettable enemy standing on the line is still collected (whether it then takes the burn or damage was not traced). Allies on the line are skipped.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's cell to the farthest target's cell, both ends included; no width, no falloff; the caster's own cell is on the line but holds an ally

effects.target: each unit of another team on the line (each once, Set); else the cast target
effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's crit reduction) only if the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false); no falloff along the line
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; applied = after AP/crit, the target's SPE_DEF division and later untraced modifiers (see core-mechanics section A for the division, ceil and minimum of 1); protect / skydiving / magicBounce targets take none. The strategy does not read takenDamage. The burn is applied first and does not change this hit (burn damage is separate TRUE damage over time).

statusEffects.target: each unit hit (the same set as the damage)
statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the target lacks IMMUNITY_BURN, rune protect and the WATER_BUBBLE passive; applied duration = requested after the target's duration reductions; replaces the running burn timer (and burn origin) only if longer. Side effects at application: a GUTS-passive target gains +5 attack once; a WELL_BAKED target gains +20 DEF and a MAGMARIZER holder +30 speed if it was not already burning; a RAWST_BERRY holder eats the berry. While burning the target takes TRUE damage of 5% max HP each second (modified by weather, items and passives; the burn tick details were read only for the base formula).

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (80, also the fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. The burn duration (2000 ms) does not depend on stars. maxPP and range are in appliesTo.

record.positionalConditions: The set of units hit depends on the caster's and the farthest target's coordinates. If the farthest target is adjacent, the line is two cells. Allies on the line are not affected. If getFarthestTarget returns nothing, the cast target ends the line (and is also the fallback victim). Unlike the dash abilities (FLAME_CHARGE, VOLT_SWITCH) the caster does not move.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast recomputes the farthest target and the line; repeated burns are not stacked (the longer remaining cooldown and its origin are kept).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 10/20/40 (1/2/3 stars) per unit hit and burn 2000 ms. Damage dealt per unit = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the target's SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers. Burn applied = 2000 ms after the target's duration reductions, or none for the immune cases listed; burn ticks are 5% max HP per second TRUE damage and are not part of the ability's SPECIAL damage.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleSpecialDamage's later modifiers (SPE_DEF division, shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers); only the shared references in core-mechanics section A were consulted
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
applyStatusDurationReductions (status duration modifiers) was not read
Burn tick modifiers (weather, Assault Vest, water effects, Well Baked, Magmarizer) beyond the base 5% max HP formula
unresolved: Scorbunny and Raboot declare passive HATCH (not covered by this record; Cinderace declares none in the catalog)
Whether an untargettable enemy on the line takes the burn and damage: the collection filter is team only and handleSpecialDamage was not traced for it
The MERCILESS clause of isTargettableBy (an attacker with the effect may target units at 10 HP or less on its own side) was read but its interaction with the team filter on the line was not traced
